# Parano1d v0.1.1 — Mainnet release correction

This patch replaces the v0.1.0 packages with binaries that embed the final
mainnet HistoryStep matrix pack.

The v0.1.0 release inadvertently embedded the pre-mainnet test pack. Those
binaries cannot validate the public mainnet chain and must not be used.

## Required action

1. Close Parano1d.
2. Delete the complete Parano1d data directory created by v0.1.0.
3. Install v0.1.1 and start again from a clean directory.

The mainnet parameters are unchanged. Only the embedded HistoryStep pack and package version are corrected.
